# DS-QM033-SCHRODINGER-DISCRETE-COCHAIN

An admitted Hermitian 2×2 H gives derivative -iHψ/hbar. The universal cleared rate identity is zero; the rate concerns sum of squared moduli, not the L1 amplitude norm. Forward Euler generally changes this mass by dt² times derivative mass. Instantaneous conservation must not be advertised as exact discrete-step unitarity.

Supported: Full Gaussian Hψ and derivative coordinates reproduce zero instantaneous mass rate and the nonzero exact Euler drift formula.

Remaining: Derive H and its units/interface; construct an exact propagator and prove the formal matrix-to-rate transport. No differential equation solution or continuum limit is provided.
